why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 should FAIL because a build that adds only a padLeft section leaves slugify undocumented. The output marks line 3 "FAIL" and gives that exact reason: "index.js exports capitalize, slugify and truncate, but README.md documents only capitalize and truncate, so slugify is missing. A PR that adds only a '## padLeft(s, width, fill)' section meets this line, yet the README list is still incomplete." It ties this to the request's "keep the README's list of functions complete". Its wrong_build is the same padLeft-only build. The item is fully caught.
